description: Election Commission - Notice under Parliment Election Act, the List of Political Parties to be  recognized for the Elections Purpose
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under Section 7(4)(b) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, publishing the official list of political parties recognized for election purposes. It specifically deals with electoral processes and is issued by the Elections Commission, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
